name: Jobbold
source:
Jobbold is an adult visual novel game with new content added regularly. Taking control of Penit, the young naked Kobold on a quest to find a job, you meet various interesting Kobolds who, in all sorts of scenarios, you get to have your way with! On the hunt to just be a clean, normal living Kobold, you'll find that the world around you is filled with putting you in position where your might and stamina are tested. Will you ever be able to get that job?

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/lewdcario11/posts] itch.io[/url]]
